text.p: Here are the highlights from Swiss newspapers on Monday:
- Swissair AG management will propose to the board of directors buying new type A-330-200 airplanes.
- Some 300 people protest against the opening of shops on Sundays in Freiburg. The protesters blocked and glued up shop doors and harassed shoppers.
- One person died and 18 were injured when cable cars crashed due to a malfunction in the Swiss mountain town of Riederalp.
- A Basle man, previously president of Basle's Chamber of Lawyers, shot and wounded a priest and a sexton in Geneva's Notre Dame church shortly after a mass last Saturday evening.
The gunman, who said that the priest had bothered him, was forced out of the church by police after barricading himself inside for six hours.
- Insurance companies Rentenanstalt/Swiss Life and Swiss Mobiliar are ending their 25-year cooperation.
- Swiss Ambassador Thomas Borer met U.S. Senator Alfonse D'Amato to discuss the issue of funds for Jewish Holocaust victims
